newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania leu little changed, money market in focus.
newsitem.headline: Romania leu little changed, money market in focus.

text.p: 0730 GMT - Romania's leu opened on Monday at around 6,950/7,050 to the dollar, slightly changed from Friday's closing quotes, which bobbed around 6,900/7,060, traders said.

* They said the interbank market was calm at the start of trading, with dollar supply outruning demand. A downslide of the leu later in the day was to be expected if the central bank (BNR) continued to buy dollars to prevent the leu from firming.

* Early trading on Monday focused on the money market, which saw a shorthage after the BNR had drained excess leu funds last Thursday. Some commercial banks were chasing leu funds to complete the minimum required reserves, traders said.
* Overnight prices were between 64 to 75 percent on Monday morning, but traders expected a gradual downtrend to start on Tuesday.
* Leu-dollar retail rates hovered around 7,100/300. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
